title: El Cenizo asks residents to donate a turkey for a family in need this Thanksgiving
excerpt: One 25-pound turkey gives a family a full Thanksgiving meal, the city said. Donations are due by Tuesday, Nov. 17, at El Cenizo City Hall.
content:
The City of El Cenizo is inviting residents to donate a turkey to help a family in need this Thanksgiving, the city announced.

One turkey of 25 pounds equals one family with a full Thanksgiving meal, according to the city.

The deadline to donate is Tuesday, Nov. 17, and turkeys can be dropped off at El Cenizo City Hall, 507 Cadena Street.

Source: City of El Cenizo, Nov. 9, 2026.
